title: FCNR deposits lift banks' Q2 deposit growth

timeline.title: FCNR deposits lift banks' Q2 deposit growth
timeline.line: Banks raised about $133 bn under RBI's FCNR(B) swap window, boosting balance sheets
more: Axis raised $10.62 bn and IndusInd $3.51 bn in FCNR(B) deposits
FCNR window closed Aug 31; ECB and OFCB windows open till Dec 31
